name: workspace-search-category
goal: Keep desktop source search within its supported route categories

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Main 50b02f29 (#55) widens shared SearchEntry to Platforms; desktop typecheck fails because workspace routes accept source categories only.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Standard workspace-search.test.ts checked identity and revisions, but not a listed entry whose shared category becomes unsupported. Desktop typecheck was absent from the upstream category change checks.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Validate the desktop category at the existing identity boundary. Keep accepted source routes and reject Platforms; require desktop typecheck and workspace search tests when shared category unions change.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
